claim.claim-text: 2. The solar cell according to claim 1, wherein the average thickness of the first passivation layer (21) is in a range from 0.1 nm to 6 nm, and the average thickness of the second passivation layer (22) is in a range from 1 nm to 30 nm.
3. The solar cell according to claim 1 or 2, wherein a thickness uniformity of the first passivation layer (21) is greater than that of the second passivation layer (22).

4. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein a thickness difference between different regions of the first passivation layer (21) is smaller than 0.5 nm, and a thickness difference between different regions of the second passivation layer (22) is greater than 0.5 nm.

5. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the first passivation layer (21) and the second passivation layer (22) further cover a peripheral side of the substrate (1), a covering area of the first passivation layer (21) on the peripheral side of the substrate (1) is less than or equal to a covering area of the second passivation layer (22) on the peripheral side of the substrate (1).

6. The solar cell according to claim 5, wherein the substrate comprises a first thickness section (1a) and a second thickness section (1b) arranged in sequence in a direction away from the first passivation layer (21); the first passivation layer (21) covers the peripheral side corresponding to the first thickness section (1a), and the second passivation layer (22) covers the peripheral side corresponding to the first thickness section (1a) and the second thickness section (1b).

7. The solar cell according to claim 6, wherein a thickness of the first thickness section (1a) is greater than or equal to 1/2 of a thickness of the substrate (1), and smaller than or equal to the thickness of the substrate (1), a sum of the thickness of the first thickness section (1a) and a thickness of the second thickness section (1b) is greater than or equal to 2/3 of the thickness of the substrate (1), and smaller than or equal to the thickness of the substrate (1).

8. The solar cell according to claim 7, wherein the thickness of the first thickness section (1a) is in a range from 10 µm to 200 µm, and the sum of the thicknesses of the first thickness section (1a) and the second thickness section (1b) is in a range from 50 µm to 200 µm.
9. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 8, being an N-type tunnel oxide passivated contact cell.
10. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the substrate (1) is an N-type silicon substrate.

11. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the material of the first passivation layer (21) and the material of the second passivation layer (22) are both aluminum oxide represented by AlO<x>, where x is in a range from 1.45 to 1.55 in the first passivation layer (21), and is in a range from 0.5 to 2 in the second passivation layer (22).
12. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein a proportion of trivalent aluminum ions of the aluminium oxide in the first passivation layer (21) is greater than 85% by mole.

13. A photovoltaic device, comprising a plurality of solar cells, the plurality of solar cells being connected in series and/or in parallel; wherein at least one of the solar cells is the solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 12.
14. A photovoltaic system, comprising the photovoltaic device according to claim 13.
